claims.conclusion: Every core H has degrees8, edges68, adjacent-pair codegree3, and nonadjacent-pair codegree4. In particular every nonedge xy has exactly3 common nonneighbors, forming a triangle.
proof: For x in H, N_H(x) is triangle-free and I4-free, hence has at most8 vertices by R(3,4)=9. Its nonneighborhood is K4-free and I3-free, hence also has at most8 vertices by complementation and the same Ramsey input. The two sizes sum16, so both are8.

For an edge xy, common neighbors form an independent set, else a K4; their size is at most3 because H is I4-free. For a nonedge xy, common nonneighbors form a clique, else an I4; they have size at most3 because H is K4-free. With both degrees8 their common-nonneighbor count is codegree(x,y)-1, so nonedge codegree is at most4.

The sum of all unordered-pair codegrees is17*binom(8,2)=476. There are68 edges and68 nonedges, and their upper bounds total68*3+68*4=476. Every bound therefore attains equality. This does not identify H with Paley17 or assert uniqueness.

conclusion: For every nonedge xy in either core, at most one t in T is nonadjacent to both x and y.
For H=C or D, write W_t=H minus N_H(t). The sets of H-nonedges induced by the seven W_t are pairwise disjoint; sum_t [binom(|W_t|,2)-e_H(W_t)]<=68.
At most six vertices t have d_H(t)=9. Consequently p>=64 and q>=64.
proof: H union T is (5,4)-free. Each H[W_t] has no I3, else with t it gives I4; it is K4-free by heredity. Hence |W_t|<=8 by R(3,4)=9 on its complement.

Fix a nonedge xy of H and its common-nonneighbor triangle Z given by critical-core-srg. If t misses x,y, it must be complete to Z: a missing t-z edge would make x,y,z,t an I4. If two vertices t,s miss x,y, a nonedge ts makes x,y,t,s an I4, whereas an edge ts makes Z union {t,s} a K5. Both are impossible. Thus the claimed nonedge packing holds for all pairs t,s, including adjacent pairs.

If |W_t|=8, F=complement(H[W_t]) is triangle-free and I4-free. We give a census-free proof that e(F)>=10. Each F-degree is2 or3: its neighborhood is independent of size at most3, and its nonneighborhood has no triangle or independent triple, so has at most5 vertices by R(3,3)=6. If F has no degree2 vertex it has12 edges. Otherwise choose a of degree2 with nonadjacent neighbors b,c. The other5 vertices induce C5, since they are triangle-free and I3-free (each degree within that5 is exactly2 by R(3,3)=6 and the three-vertex elementary bounds). The independent cycle-neighbor sets of b,c must have union size at least3, since two common missed cycle vertices would form an I4 with b,c. Hence F has at least2+5+3=10 edges.

If all seven t had d_H(t)=9, all seven W_t would have size8 and would consume at least70 distinct core nonedges. H has only68 nonedges. Therefore one signature has size at least10 and total attachment is at least6*9+10=64.

All mixed homogeneous statements are direct forbidden5-set obstructions and hereditary (4,4)-freeness of the opposite core, followed where needed by R(3,4)=9. They constrain actual intersections, not only intersection cardinalities.

coverage.labelled: Fix ordered roots v,u and named ordered sets C=(c1,...,c17),D=(d1,...,d17),T=(t1,...,t7). Retain all labelled (4,4)-free core edge sets C,D and all named matrices M,P,Q and T edge sets satisfying the necessary conditions. Every graph in the branch has such a representation by its actual adjacency, hence is covered. The scalar tuple(h,L,R,r) is uniquely determined in a fixed representation and yields disjoint scalar buckets. Individual degree signatures may refine these buckets without dropping any assignments.
coverage.unlabelled_warning: A census of unlabelled17-cores alone does not supply labelled coverage of cross matrices. It is safe only to include every bijection from each representative to the named core, or to prove a complete compatible simultaneous orbit rule on cores and all incident blocks. No independent quotient by row or column sums, or unsafe isomorphism selection, is made here. No uniqueness of the17-core is assumed.
coverage.remaining_obstruction: The arithmetic envelope is nonempty. A graph must still simultaneously realize both (5,4)-free24-vertex sides, the strict critical nonedge packing on both sides, all vertex budgets, and actual C-D matrix compatibility. In particular the mixed K5/I5 rectangles across C,D,T remain; pair counts and moments are not asserted sufficient. Main owns the exact forbidden-cell partition. There is no exclusion of k1.
